memory.content: Developing an idle/incremental game with ChopDrone, helpers, shuttle, fusion, progression, and Overseer systems.
Game team lead coordinates Designer, Developer, Security, Database, and Tester; Mon/Wed health checks and Saturday pitches; pull the product owner in for decisions.
For drone cable feel: prefer readable silhouette and timing (catenary sag, latch whip) over heavier Verlet — presentational VFX only, fx_quality gated, no save schema.
World-jump cinematics: scroll+streak language, Low/High FX split, ~3.5s beat budgets, radial latch poses, hooks on the transit manager — no new physics; cinematic non-authoritative.

Late-game tee starvation: denser-first kill-pressure retune (soft band then hard under ~5–6), scroll later/softer, keep row-visible targets readable; constants only, local on-screen standing, no save/session persist.
